data.name: Andisheh
data.long_meaning: Andisheh is a Persian name derived from the word 'andish', which means 'wisdom' or 'guidance'. In Islamic culture, it represents the pursuit of knowledge and the desire for enlightenment. This name is often given to girls whose parents aspire for their intellectual growth and success.

in_arabic.name: اندیشه

in_hindi.name: अंदिशे

in_pashto.name: انديښه
in_pashto.long_meaning: انديښه د عربی ریښو څخه اخیستل شوی دی، د 'نَظَرَ' څخه مشتق دی چې معنی یې د لیدو او فکر کولو څخه ده. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو کې د ښه او ستايښمنی فکر لرلو معنی دی.

in_english.name: Andisheh
in_english.long_meaning: Andisheh originates from the Arabic root 'nazar,' meaning to look or think. It signifies having good, pleasant, and commendable thoughts. In Islamic tradition, the name reflects a person with thoughtful and positive ideas. Historically, it has been used across various Muslim cultures to denote someone with a contemplative and optimistic nature.

historical_references.reference: Andisheh is a Persian term meaning 'wisdom' or 'intelligence'. It was used as a title for some of the highest-ranking advisors to the Seljuk Sultans during the Middle Ages. The Seljuk Empire was a major Islamic power from the 11th to the 13th centuries, centered in present-day Turkey.

historical_references.reference: Andisheh was also the name of a renowned Persian philosopher and scholar who lived in the 13th century during the Mongol invasion of Persia. He is known for his work 'Andisheh-Nameh' or 'The Book of Wisdom', which is a collection of moral and philosophical teachings, and his influence on Persian literature and culture.
